description: Pinned upstream source manifest for the Pocket Realm offline build. Every active entry has an exact commit, license, and redistribution verdict. The canonical architecture and delivery reference is docs/SPP_Classics_WoW_1.12.1_Android_Port_Report.docx; this file governs source selection only.

native_build_host.msys2_env: MSYS2_ROOT / MSYS_HOME (machine-local; default G:\msys64). Complete Unix-style perl for OpenSSL, gcc for Boost b2 bootstrap.
native_build_host.ndk_junction: SDK\ndk-link -> currently-selected SDK\ndk\<version>, recreated if stale (avoids Windows 8.3 short-name path mismatch in OpenSSL toolchain detection)

dependencies_built.boost: 1.86.0 (program_options, thread, regex, serialization, filesystem, system; static runtime)
dependencies_built.sqlite: 3.46.1 amalgamation (historical O03/O04 exploratory backend; not the production database baseline)

native_build_host.playerbots_integration: BUILD_PLAYERBOTS=ON; cmangos FetchContent (SOURCE_DIR form) reads native/playerbots mirrored into native/cmangos/src/modules/PlayerBots by build_native.py ensure_playerbots()
native_build_host.emulator_test_abi: x86_64 is the required G1/G2 development and integration ABI via the fixed Android AVD lanes. arm64-v8a remains the physical release ABI; any distributed x86 artifact must be explicitly declared by the release matrix.
native_build_host.planned_database_dependency: Pinned native MariaDB source/build is selected and added by O08 before G2 acceptance.

sources.role: O06 G1 x86 client runtime. amd64-wow64 variant: multilib build with lib/wine/i386-unix stripped, relying on Wine 11.0+ default new-WoW64 for 32-bit PE. Exec'd (via the APK-managed glibc loader) in the :client process; not an Android .so. Wine-owned builtin PE modules are canonical APK assets; the closure also requires glibc + X11/freetype/fontconfig (see the lockfile).

redistribution.notes: Wine binaries are LGPL-2.1. Source correspondence is traceable: Kron4ek build commit + MIT build scripts + upstream Wine 11.14 vanilla (no patches). No formal written LGPL source-offer; Wine source is public at upstream_wine.source_url. Source reproduction from upstream remains the production/distribution bar (ADR-014, future). This provider supplies Wine's own ELF + PE closure ONLY; it does not supply glibc, the X server, the loader, or solve Android APK execution placement (DECISIONS #12, ADR-013).

sources.runtime_scope_notes: Provides Wine's own ELF closure + builtin PE modules only. The glibc/X11/font closure comes from termux-glibc-packages-c9d4de5; the X server from xserver-winlator-ca3d735; the loader is the glibc build's ld-linux-x86-64.so.2.

sources.role:
The ENTIRE glibc-side runtime closure for the Wine runtime: glibc 2.43-1 (loader ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 + libc/libpthread/libdl/libm/librt) AND libX11 (+ libxcb/libxau/libxdmcp/libXext) AND freetype AND fontconfig — the mandatory DT_NEEDED set Kron4ek Wine 11.14 requires for wineboot + a windowed PE (winex11.drv NtTerminateProcess'es if libX11.so.6 is absent). All packages built from this single commit; loader + libs from the same glibc 2.43-1 build (no loader/libc ABI skew).

GCC-LIBS RECIPE DIVERGENCE (recorded honestly): the c9d4de5 main pin's gcc-libs 14.2.1 recipe cannot build against the cgct image's gcc 16.1.0 cross-compiler (C++20 char8_t incompatibility in libcody), and its git+sourceware.org clone is persistently HTTP-429 rate-limited. We adopt upstream's open 'upd-gcc' branch (commit 845d0e313f53535de28abba0fb42b07e960cc031, authored 2026-07-14 by Maxython) for the gcc-libs package ONLY: it bumps gcc-libs to 16.1.0 via the official GNU tarball (https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gcc/gcc-16.1.0/gcc-16.1.0.tar.xz, SHA-256 50efb4d94c3397aff3b0d61a5abd748b4dd31d9d3f2ab7be05b171d36a510f79), which resolves both issues (no git clone; 16.1.0 source matches the 16.1.0 compiler). All other 8 packages remain on the c9d4de5 pin. This is the same source provider (termux-pacman/glibc-packages), just the gcc-libs package's build recipe from a newer branch.
sources.build_recipe: gpkg/<package>/build.sh per package (see schemas/wine-runtime-lockfile.json for the per-package source hashes/versions/licenses)

redistribution.notes: All packages built from source via their gpkg build scripts at the pinned commit. The glibc Android patch set (SysV SHM, fakesyscall, passwd/group) is the full termux-pacman set. Output hashes recorded in the lockfile.

sources.role: O06 in-app X server (display + input). CURRENT STATE (S-3 wired): the Java X11 wire-protocol sources are vendored to runtime/xserver-winlator/ (143 .java files: com.winlator.xserver core + errors + events + requests + extensions, com.winlator.xconnector, com.winlator.renderer (+effects/material), com.winlator.core subset, com.winlator.math, com.winlator.widget.XServerView, plus 6 app-shell-coupling stubs). The native transport libwinlator.so is VENDORED, BUILT, and PACKAGED into the APK: the complete pinned native source set (9 .c + 17 headers at native/xserver-winlator/cpp/, vendored UNMODIFIED from app/src/main/cpp/winlator/), NDK-built 16 KB-aligned (413864 bytes) via tools/build_xserver_winlator.py. The JNI method names match the vendored Java classes' package paths exactly (Java_com_winlator_xconnector_{XConnectorEpoll,XInputStream,XOutputStream}_* + Java_com_winlator_xserver_Drawable_*), drop-in for System.loadLibrary("winlator"). NO Java reimplementation of the native epoll/SCM_RIGHTS layer exists. The only build-time adaptation is a force-include header (include/pocket_ndk_compat.h) supplying transitive stdlib/time.h includes; the .c/.h content is byte-identical to the pinned commit. The X-server is GDI-only: XServer.setupExtensions() advertises BigReq + Sync + XComposite only (GLX/DRI3/MIT-SHM/Present removed - native support not built, no no-op advertisements). S-3 harness in WineSpikeRunner.runS3 creates <appTmp>/.X11-unix/X0, starts the X-server headless, launches the 32-bit self-test PE with DISPLAY=:0 via the synchronous proot run, requires POCKET_SELFTEST_WINDOW + POCKET_SELFTEST_OK + exit zero.
sources.license: LGPL-2.1 (verified from root LICENSE at this commit; NOT MIT)

redistribution.notes: Vendored as an adapted, attributed fork. Java source retained at runtime/xserver-winlator/ for the LGPL-2.1 source-offer obligation. Native C source (pinned cpp/winlator/src/*.c + include/*.h) will be vendored into the tree when libwinlator.so is built. The trim list (couplings to Winlator's app shell stubbed for the spike) is recorded in docs/patches/wine-provider-provenance.md.

sources.role: Fallback ONLY. Built and added to the exec set if the Phase-1 spike proves native-glibc loader invocation fails for some native child. The exact failure that triggered the fallback is recorded. termux/proot publishes no binary releases; this is source-only.

redistribution.notes: Built from source only if the spike selects the proot path. Not built by default.

sources.role: Hard runtime dependency of proot (termux/proot@a89b3732 links -ltalloc unconditionally). Built as a single Bionic .so (libtalloc.so) for the same x86_64 target as proot. Built ONLY when the proot fallback path is selected.

redistribution.notes: talloc.c is a single translation unit from the samba talloc library. Built with a synthesized minimal config.h declaring the features Bionic provides (no glibc-specific code). Source retained for the LGPL-3.0 source-offer obligation.

sources.role: Host cross-toolchain for the O06 self-test PE (32-bit Win32). Produces pocket_selftest.exe via tools/build_selftest_pe.py. The source-archive SHA-256 is computed and recorded at fetch time (MSYS2 publishes only a PGP .sig for source archives, not a hash).
